prompts.prompt:
Use-case: stylized-concept, original production background painting for the Phase Quest game title screen, not a UI mockup. Produce one polished wide landscape 16:9 illustration, ideally 2048x1152. Elevated orthographic/isometric-style view, clean sparse stepped block terrain, thin material-colored contours, bevel highlights, upper-left soft daylight, distinct simple top/side values and gentle contact shadows, muted water and low-detail cuboid trees. Same connected mainland throughout all three regional paintings: a broad stepped river valley leads from snowy high terraces toward sunny lowland fields and a pale laboratory ridge; flowing water and the distant ridge visually connect the regions, never floating islands or separate planets. Distant other regions are only vague silhouettes, not a playable map. Large spacious surfaces, subtle aerial perspective, tasteful atmospheric softness, original finished 2D game-art look rather than a detailed Minecraft scene. Quiet dark mid-value central area spanning the middle 45 percent of the frame for a future large cream title and centered vertical menu; recognizable scenery mainly surrounds it, no opaque blank rectangle. Camera should feel like looking across original Phase Quest world art, with coherent restrained green/cream/slate/brass palettes. Paint ONLY environmental background: absolutely no text, logos, HUD, UI, button, icon, cursor, borders, characters, collectibles, crystals, machines with visible controls, puzzle layouts, progression gates, signs, marked routes, numbered areas or discovery/fog map. No copied Crystarise proprietary scene, logo or character. No pink/lavender-haired character. This is an atmospheric spoiler-free regional overview and may not expose locked puzzle solutions.
Regional subject: snowy Melting Gardens. Pale snow-covered broad stepped earth terraces, sparse dark blocky evergreen clusters, a sheltered muted blue river inlet and a few simple wood shelter roofs far from center. In the distance toward one edge, the snow thins into muted green lowland; the farthest pale ridge suggests the laboratory region. Snow #e8f1ed, cool shadow #bdced2, dirt #8b7262/#6d5c52, pine #456c64, water #4d8b9d; tiny restrained warm reflected light, no visible heater/puzzle. Keep central river/snow forms low-contrast enough for large menu lettering.

Regional subject: Sunpetal Vale. Broad sunny green stepped clearings, sparse small orchard clusters with simple cuboid green canopies, a few understated greenhouse/shelter roof silhouettes at the distant side, a muted blue river bend. Distant snowy upper terrace and the pale laboratory ridge clearly belong to this connected mainland. Regional subject: Phaseworks Laboratory. A pale low-rise research campus on broad stepped stone/grass terraces above the same muted river valley, a few simple ivory/slate flat-roof observatory and laboratory exterior volumes and restrained brass trim. Architecture clustered at side margins, no interior cutaway, instruments, chamber controls, gas, lab samples or puzzle equipment. One distant snowy upper terrace and green lowland canopy connect it visually to the other two mainland regions. Floor #d9dfd9/#b3c1c2, sides #8a969b/#5c6b75, foliage #718a76, metal #bfa77f, glass tint #b3d7dc, water #528d9b.
